name: Startup and original catalogue preserved
Malformed and unavailable storage do not block startup
Valid old cosmetics and achievement progress survive migration
Distinct fusions accumulate across runs, repeats do not
95 fusion creations and final upgrades have finite stats and correct costs
New scalable fusion is not prematurely counted as maxed
Rainbow and XP grant TWO choices in order
Multiple earned levels are all delivered
Wave upgrade advances exactly one round
All four boss death paths reward level and open shop
Fourth boss reward comes before victory; continue opens shop
End-of-build victory and infinite mode still work
Death aborts the frame before healing/loot and cannot submit twice
Dog rescue interrupts death without ending the run
Protected and reduced damage statistics reflect actual life loss
Right button never holds fire; right release does not release left
Pause freezes gameplay clock and protection expiry
Music pauses in menus and resumes after choices
Victory records score/wave achievements
Scales award only the additional entitlement after continuing
Clean rounds in infinite mode update streak
Achievements do not write storage for every shot
Same ten-second movement at 30, 60 and 120 rendered FPS
Restart clears pause/input, target, queues and music state
